title: It is not yours.
description:
It is not yours. Your mitochondria carry their own genome. It reads as bacterial, and it says they descend from a group called the alpha-proteobacteria.

She published under her married name, before she was Lynn Margulis. More than a dozen journals turned the paper down before one took it.

Two of them are textbooks now. Mitochondria were bacteria. So were the chloroplasts in plants. Both were settled by reading the DNA those organelles still carry.

Still has nothing behind it. She said the cell's whip-like tail came from a swallowed bacterium too. No genome has ever been found in it. It is the part nobody quotes.

Vindicated is not the same as correct.

Sources:
- https://doi.org/10.1091/mbc.E16-07-0509
- https://embryo.asu.edu/pages/origin-mitosing-cells-1967-lynn-sagan
